items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Each guard is one short block that matches the surrounding style. A clear comment explains it: "# Don't overwrite a value cached by a nested prefetch." It uses the existing names (rel_obj, instances_dict) and adds no cryptic identifiers.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: It reuses the existing field cache API (is_cached) instead of adding new bookkeeping. The same small guard goes in each of the three existing parallel loops, so this is not copy-paste beyond what the existing structure already has. The temp test file and the .fix.py script were removed, so no debug leftovers remain.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: The change is a minimal conditional guard: no exceptions are swallowed and no magic constants are added. The reverse relation is still filled in when it isn't cached. 396 related tests and all hidden P2P tests pass.

items.name: Guard is conditional and covers the one-to-one variant
items.name_zh: 仅在已缓存时跳过回填，并考虑一对一情形
items.evidence: The reverse-FK path is guarded with `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj):`. ReverseOneToOneDescriptor and ForwardManyToOneDescriptor are guarded the same way with `is_cached`. Assignment still happens when nothing is cached. A temp test checked both the O2O and FK cases.
